Name: Ezekiel and viska portrait for immersive unique children talk
Author: Emiliaeda12
Description:
I made a portrait of Ezekiel and viska from king's raid!

Just put the PNG file in unique children talk/assets/portrait and if you want you can change the name of the png file to your child's name for example:
Ezekiel.png
Viska.png


Also check out arknirs mod:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307

Downloads.Description: Copy the PNG file and move it to portraits in unique children talk
